build_autoaugment_policy: build a python module to apply the v0 AutoAugment policy to an image tensor
build_randaugment_policy: build a python module to apply RandAugment with N layers and magnitude M to an image
create_image_augmentation_pipeline: create a function that applies a sequence of image augmentation operations from a policy
create_cutout_augmentation: create a function that applies cutout augmentation by masking a random region of the image
create_solarize_augmentation: create a function that solarizes an image by inverting pixels above a threshold
